mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME FROM sales s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.SELLER_ID = u.ID WHERE s.SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} ORDER BY s.CREATED_TIME DESC
SELECT s.*, u.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME FROM sales s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.SELLER_ID = u.ID WHERE s.SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales ( SALE_ITEM_ID, QTY, SALE_STATUS, JUDGE_KIND_NAME, CUT_NAME, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, DETAIL_DESCRIPTION, WEIGHT, GRADE, TRACEABILITY_NUM, SELLER_ID, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES ( SALE_ITEM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{qty}, #{saleStatus}, #{judgeKindName}, #{cutName}, #{title}, #{description}, #{detailDescription}, #{weight}, #{grade}, #{traceabilityNum}, #{sellerId}, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO product_images ( IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_TYPE, IMAGE_URL, IS_THUMBNAIL, ORDER_INDEX, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES ( image_seq.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{productType}, #{imageUrl}, #{isThumbnail}, #{orderIndex}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales SET QTY = #{qty}, SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus}, JUDGE_KIND_NAME = #{judgeKindName}, CUT_NAME = #{cutName}, TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, DETAIL_DESCRIPTION = #{detailDescription}, WEIGHT = #{weight}, GRADE = #{grade}, TRACEABILITY_NUM = #{traceabilityNum} WHERE SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_images WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND PRODUCT_TYPE = #{productType}
